subject: Supplier chain visibility & onshore fallback options
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@cleardata.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cleardata.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: third-party processing inventory + data path diagram

Hi Marissa,

Hope you're well. We're finalizing our vendor review for ClearData's data flows and need a snapshot of Redwood's current third-party processing inventory (subprocessors) for services that touch customer content or telemetry. Specifically we need: 

- A simple inventory list (name, country of operation, purpose, encryption in transit/rest)
- A one-page data path diagram showing where telemetry/metrics and customer payloads may transit (edge -> relay -> storage)
- Any planned changes in the next 90 days, and whether you have onshore fallback options for EU/US residency in case of temporary cross-border restrictions.

Can you get us the documents and a short note on fallback options by EOD Wednesday (2026-09-22)? We're trying to keep the procurement timeline tight.

Thanks,
Alex
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
ClearData Systems

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@cleardata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: third-party processing inventory + data path diagram

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We're happy to provide this. Quick notes on approach so we give you exactly what you need: 

1) Inventory: we'll export our live processor roster and annotate purpose and jurisdiction. We'll include whether the processor has access to customer payloads vs telemetry.
2) Data path diagram: we'll produce a simplified PDF showing typical ingress routes and fallback routing for onshore options.
3) Planned changes: we'll surface any scheduled vendor rotations or temporary bridges in the next 90 days (if any).

Kimberly, can you pull the latest roster + encryption matrix? Rishi, can you draft 1-paragraph text for onshore fallback options and any operational constraints (e.g., expected failover window, costs)?

Alex — we'll aim to get an annotated spreadsheet + diagram to you by EOD Wednesday. If there's a preferred doc template or a place to upload (DocuSign/Drive/HubSpot record), let us know.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: third-party processing inventory + data path diagram

On it — attaching the export and a compressed diagram set for Marissa to review before we send externally. Notes in the sheet: processor role, region, whether they handle payload (P) or telemetry (T), contractual encryption (TLS/at-rest AES-256), and whether we have an onshore mirror option.

Attachment stubs:
- cleardata_subproc_inventory.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- dataflow_edge_map.pdf (diagram)

Operational note for Rishi: two of the CDN partners have temporary onshore mirror capacity in eu-west-1 and us-east-1 but require 48–72 hours of sync for full routing cutover. There's also a short-term commercial addendum (est. $5k/month) to enable guaranteed onshore egress.

Kimberly
Sr. Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@cleardata.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: third-party processing inventory + data path diagram

Hi all — forwarding the consolidated packet for ClearData. Please see the attached summarized options doc for onshore fallback and the annotated roster. Quick summary here: 

- Inventory: 18 processors, 4 have access to customer payloads (storage/archival), remainder handle telemetry or orchestration.
- Planned changes: a telemetry relay rotation scheduled week of Oct 11; no planned storage vendor changes in the next 90 days.
- Onshore fallback: we have mirror capability via CDN-A (eu/us) and a paid egress guarantee from CDN-B. Expected operational cutover 48–72 hours; archived payload restore could take up to 5 days depending on dataset size.

Attachments sent to your Drive folder: cleardata_subproc_inventory.xlsx, dataflow_edge_map.pdf, redwood_onshore-options-summary.docx.

Alex — let us know if you want a short call (20 min) to walk through the failover steps or if the documents are sufficient.

Regards,
Rishi
Director, Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference
